# Open MindMap

Open MindMap is a modular React mind map runtime designed for AI-generated and human-edited knowledge structures.
Current site and package target: v0.9.0.

## Primary resources
- Documentation: https://mindmap.u14.app/docs/
- Getting started: https://mindmap.u14.app/docs/getting-started/
- Markdown syntax: https://mindmap.u14.app/docs/syntax/
- AI generation: https://mindmap.u14.app/docs/ai/
- Custom styling: https://mindmap.u14.app/docs/styling/
- API reference: https://mindmap.u14.app/docs/api/
- Playground: https://mindmap.u14.app/playground/
- Source: https://github.com/u14app/mindmap
- npm: @xiangfa/mindmap

## Runtime entries
- @xiangfa/mindmap/core - parser, serializer, layout, patch controller, streaming, standalone SVG generation
- @xiangfa/mindmap/static - non-interactive React SVG rendering
- @xiangfa/mindmap/viewer - read-only pan, zoom, fit, selection, and accessible semantic tree
- @xiangfa/mindmap/editor - base editing surface and feature host

## Optional features
history, search, import, export, markdown-editor, and ai are independent subpath exports with independent stylesheets.

## Documentation map
- Syntax guide covers outline roots, indentation, inline formatting, links and images, remarks, comments, task markers, and extensions.
- AI guide covers host-owned generators, delta streaming, cancellation, attachments, provider requests, and rollback behavior.
- Styling guide covers theme modes, semantic theme tokens, runtime classes, and SVG or PNG export.
- API reference covers public entrypoints, surface props, refs, controller and stream methods, events, shortcuts, and utilities.
